sources.text:
Meridian Scholars Grant — 2026-27 (FICTIONAL DEMO).
Eligibility: Applicants must be enrolled full-time in an undergraduate programme.
Application deadline is 15 November 2026.
Documents required: identity proof, marksheet, and household income certificate.
Application process: Apply online through the fictional programme portal.
Award amount: INR 30000 per academic year.
Selection criteria: Selection is based on academic merit.
